# DPA · SDT — full reference

## Overview
Document partnership agreements between crypto wallet holders, link wallets to self-declared passport details, and record participation shares.
Author: Maxim Osovsky.
Author profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT
Website: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/

## Core concepts
SDT means Self-Declared Token.
An SDT links a wallet to a digest of self-declared passport details and bank-trace fields.
DPA means Decentralized Partnership Agreement.
A DPA records the version and hash of off-chain terms.
It records participant wallets, allocations and individual acceptances.
The workspace connects declarations, agreement evidence and participation records.

## Features
- Browser-based agreement drafting and allocation preparation.
- Invitation review and agreement evidence inspection.
- Public agreement example and acceptance records.
- Local declaration hashing.
- Wallet-based deployment and acceptance workflows.
- Participation records and unit claims.
- Historical declaration comparison.
- JSON and printable HTML technical reports.
- Downloadable agreement evidence.
- Share-sale experiments.
- Evidence packages.
- Privacy, terms and operator contact pages.

## Historical declaration comparison
Page: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/verify.html
Inputs: DPA or DPAFormation address, acceptance wallet, optional acceptance transaction hash, and 13 exact original declaration fields.
The page computes a SHA-256 digest and compares it with the snapshot stored at acceptance.
Contract provenance, receipt/event context and the recovered signer are checked.
Original declaration strings are processed locally in the browser.
Reports can be downloaded as JSON and printable HTML.
The export provides a selectable option to include original declaration strings.

## Public example
Page: https://maximosovsky.github.io/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/dpa.html?example=1
The example records individual acceptances by two synthetic wallets.
Allocation: 6,000 / 4,000 of 10,000 claimed units (60 / 40).
Agreement contract: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xB23Ed35bf06D90FF197d00f0792f918808794ecd
Units contract: https://sepolia.basescan.org/address/0xe604299A2166A5cAE3E72Cd1df25427F06094821
Archived text: https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/blob/main/synthetic-offchain-agreement-exact.txt

## Technology
Static HTML, browser JavaScript modules and CSS.
Ethereum-compatible wallets and RPC.
Published network: Base Sepolia.
Hosting: GitHub Pages.

## Quick start
Open the published workspace, example or comparison page.
For local serving, run from a parent directory:
git clone https://github.com/maximosovsky/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT.git
python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/Decentralized-Partnership-Agreements-DPA-Self-Declared-Tokens-SDT/
